_doc: Buffered 14-7 vdW of the ML atoms refitted to the MuPE(ML) electrostatics (AMOEBA+/Poltype 2 style): R_min and ε factors per ligand and atom class, fitted to 18 QM ligand–water dimer curves (ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPPD; per-ligand fit with regularization 0.3, two orientations). Applied by mlmmpol/ml_vdw.py.
